card.name: Word before effect in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The ending of "antihypertensive" in the NSAID interaction warning for ACE inhibitors and ARBs, just before "effect of". Also fires on a few similar words in fixed label sentences, such as "clinical" before "status" and "CV" before "event".

modes.label: Antihypertensive effect sentence
modes.description: The word "antihypertensive" completed just before "effect of ACE inhibitors" or "angiotensin II receptor antagonists" in the NSAID interaction text.

modes.label: Other fixed label phrases
modes.description: A modifier word in a set label sentence that is followed by a noun such as status or event.
modes.example: initiate appropriate supportive treatment as dictated by the patient’s<< clinical>> status.

card.writes: It suppresses "of" and "thereof" and similar linking words, so it seems to favor the next word being a noun like "effect" over a linking word.
card.plain: It marks a spot in a stock label sentence where a noun such as "effect" is expected next, most clearly after "antihypertensive" in the NSAID warning.
